option_relations.rationale: Thymic carcinoma is a type of thymic carcinoma. Paraneoplastic syndrome (likely Myasthenia Gravis) is a common complication of thymic tumors, but the option itself is a broader category that includes the specific leaf.
Type A thymoma is a different type of thymic tumor than thymic carcinoma. MINOCA is a cardiac condition unrelated to the thymic carcinoma leaf.
Coronary microvascular dysfunction is a cardiac condition unrelated to the thymic carcinoma leaf.
Acute coronary syndrome (Type 2 myocardial infarction) is a cardiac condition unrelated to the thymic carcinoma leaf.
